title: Part 23: where the change's cost is computed and kept
context: Nothing counts cost today. Usage lives in the session transcript and one transcript per subagent (~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl); hook payloads carry transcript_path and agent_transcript_path. The mod cannot read files over 4 MiB and may not call the network, so cost must be computed Node-side. Transcripts grow to tens of MB.

options.label: Node computes cost into a per-change bundle file cost.json at Stop and SubagentStop (record-only, errors logged, the hook's exit and output unchanged), reading only new transcript bytes since the last run (offset cache under .paqad/session/hud/); window = the change's open row to its seal; money from a dated price table shipped in paqad (prices from platform.claude.com, 2026-10-19), always labelled estimate; the snapshot and /paqad cost only read cost.json
